role: Excluded calibration only; no observation from these runs enters the later primary campaign.
physical_target: Identical classical H+H2 BKMP2 Cartesian Jacobi rate-flux ensemble and physical-domain guard as the original frozen P1 campaign.

candidates.label: Exact old-kernel control, independently verified byte-for-byte on a separate small test.

xi_move.out_of_interval: Reject to the same state; no truncation renormalization or target-domain change.

unchanged_other_moves: adjacent-window exchange with random parity and unequal stiffness
mathematical_checks: Four inverse/Jacobian/spring/MH identity tests; zero-xi version exactly reproduces original P1 observations, RNG and geometries; one/three-xi exact restart checks.

analysis.selection_metric: Maximum of whole-seed log-rate variance times 20000 and block log-rate variance times 5000, multiplied by process CPU seconds per sweep. No paper value or distance to the oracle enters selection.
analysis.cpu_cost: Use process CPU time for fresh complete calibration runs; wall time is retained but is affected by other shared jobs.
diagnostics: complete per-seed and per-block rates retained
analysis.uncertainty_scope: Block fluctuations are calibration diagnostics. They are not silently substituted for independent full-seed primary uncertainty.

primary_campaign: Choose and register one fixed kernel/budget using only this excluded calibration, then start new seeds; retain the same 1% precision, 2% oracle agreement and stationarity criteria. This calibration JSON does not define the later primary campaign.

registration_events.event: Before all calibration data: harden checkpoint integrity, complete-settings fingerprint, shape/counter validation, and source guard.

checkpoint_integrity: Per-array SHA256 envelope, complete settings fingerprint, declared array dimensions, and source guard before atomic replace; the zero-additional-move physics remains byte-identical to the old sampler.
